summary_en: 1,244,100 shares (1.50% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-18 at closing price of ¥3,215/share, aggregate limit ¥3,999,781,500. Results to be announced after market close same day.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Nakanishi Inc. announced on 2026-08-17 that its board of directors has authorized the execution of a specific treasury stock acquisition programme. The company will acquire up to 1,244,100 ordinary shares (1.50% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 2026-08-18 at the prior trading day's closing price of ¥3,215 per share. The aggregate purchase limit is ¥3,999,781,500. The order will be placed in the morning session (08:45 JST) and is valid only for that trading session. Acquisition results will be announced after market close on the same day. As of 2026-07-31, no shares had been acquired under the authorizations from the 2026-02-12 and 2026-08-07 board resolutions. Treasury holdings at that date totalled 9,166,718 shares against 83,051,482 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
